vocabulary.note_en: A pronoun takes the place of a noun.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the person who is speaking
vocabulary.note_en: Always write it as a capital letter.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the person or people you are talking to
vocabulary.note_ar: نفس الكلمة للمفرد والجمع، للمذكر والمؤنث
vocabulary.note_en: The same word for one person or many, male or female.

vocabulary.meaning_en: one male person
vocabulary.example: This is Omar. He is my brother.

vocabulary.meaning_en: one female person
vocabulary.example: This is Mona. She is my sister.

vocabulary.meaning_en: one thing or animal (not a person)
vocabulary.example: This is my car. It is new.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the speaker and one or more other people
vocabulary.example: Salma and I like English. We study every day.

vocabulary.meaning_en: two or more people, animals or things
vocabulary.note_en: Put your tongue between your teeth for th.
vocabulary.example: The cats are hungry. They want milk.

a tool with two blades for cutting paper

vocabulary.meaning_en: short trousers

fine_lines.title: he vs she vs it
fine_lines.explanation_ar: he للإنسان المذكر المفرد (ولد، رجل، أب). she للإنسان المؤنث المفرد (بنت، امرأة، أم). it لأي شيء أو حيوان مفرد ليس إنسانًا. يمكن أن نقول he أو she لحيوان نعرف أنه ذكر أو أنثى مثل lion و hen.
fine_lines.explanation_en: He is for one male person. She is for one female person. It is for one thing or animal. We can use he or she for an animal when we know it is male or female, like a lion or a hen.

examples.sentence: My uncle is here. He is tall.
My aunt is here. She is kind.
The chair is old. It is brown.

fine_lines.title: it vs they
fine_lines.explanation_ar: it لشيء واحد فقط (مفرد). إذا كانوا أكثر من واحد، سواء ناسًا أو أشياء أو حيوانات، نقول they.
fine_lines.explanation_en: It is for one thing only. For more than one person, thing or animal, use they.

examples.sentence: The cat is small. It is white.
The cats are small. They are white.

fine_lines.title: you (one) vs you (many)
fine_lines.explanation_ar: you كلمة واحدة تعني أنتَ وأنتِ وأنتم. نفهم المعنى من الموقف.
fine_lines.explanation_en: You is the same word for one person or many people. The situation shows the meaning.

examples.sentence: Ali, you are a good student.
Class, you are all good students.

fine_lines.title: we vs they
fine_lines.explanation_ar: we تشمل المتكلم (أنا + غيري). they لا تشمل المتكلم (هم فقط).
fine_lines.explanation_en: We includes the speaker (me + others). They does not include the speaker.

examples.sentence: Mom and I are at home. We are happy.
Mom and Dad are at home. They are happy.

expressions.phrase: This is Omar. He is my brother.
expressions.meaning_en: Introducing a boy, then using he.
expressions.example: This is Omar. He is my brother.

expressions.phrase: This is Rudy. She is my friend.
expressions.meaning_en: Introducing a girl, then using she.
expressions.example: This is Rudy. She is my friend.
Look at the screen. It is big.

expressions.meaning_en: Another person + I = we. Put I last.
expressions.example: My family and I live in Alexandria.

grammar.title: What is a pronoun?
grammar.explanation_ar: الضمير (pronoun) كلمة نستخدمها بدلًا من الاسم حتى لا نكرره. بدلًا من: Ahmed is a clever boy. Ahmed gets up early. نقول: Ahmed is a clever boy. He gets up early.
grammar.explanation_en: A pronoun is a word we use instead of a noun so we do not repeat the noun again and again.
examples: Ahmed is a clever boy. He gets up early.
My car is red. It is fast.

grammar.title: The seven subject pronouns
grammar.explanation_ar: ضمائر الفاعل سبعة: I (أنا)، you (أنت/أنتِ/أنتم)، he (هو للمذكر)، she (هي للمؤنث)، it (لغير الإنسان المفرد)، we (نحن)، they (هم للعاقل وغير العاقل). تأتي في أول الجملة قبل الفعل. ويُكتب I دائمًا بحرف كبير.
grammar.explanation_en: There are seven subject pronouns: I, you, he, she, it, we, they. They come at the start of a sentence, before the verb. Always write I as a capital letter.

grammar.title: Choosing the right pronoun
grammar.explanation_ar: اسأل: هل هو إنسان؟ مذكر → he، مؤنث → she. ليس إنسانًا ومفرد → it. أنا + شخص آخر → we. أكثر من واحد (بدوني) → they.
grammar.explanation_en: Ask: Is it a person? Male → he, female → she. Not a person and one → it. Me + another person → we. More than one (not me) → they.

grammar.title: Things with two parts use they
grammar.explanation_ar: بعض الأشياء تتكون من جزأين متشابهين فتكون دائمًا جمعًا ونقول عنها they: scissors (مقص)، glasses (نظارة)، shorts (شورت)، والأحذية والجوارب.
grammar.explanation_en: Some things have two matching parts, so they are always plural and we use they: scissors, glasses, shorts, shoes, socks.
examples: My glasses are new. They are black.
The scissors are sharp. They are on the table.

questions.question: Which pronoun can replace "my grandfather"?
questions.explanation_en: A grandfather is a male person, so we use he.

questions.question: Which pronoun can replace "the chair"?
questions.explanation_ar: الكرسي شيء مفرد غير إنسان، فنقول it.
questions.explanation_en: A chair is one thing, so we use it.

questions.question: Which pronoun can replace "Mom and I"?
Which pronoun can replace "the cats"?
questions.explanation_ar: القطط جمع، و they تُستخدم للجمع العاقل وغير العاقل.
questions.explanation_en: Cats are more than one, so we use they.

questions.question: Which pronoun can replace "Laila"?
questions.explanation_en: Laila is a girl, so we use she.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
questions.explanation_ar: الضمير I يُكتب دائمًا بحرف كبير.
questions.explanation_en: The pronoun I is always a capital letter.

questions.question: "My glasses are new. ___ are black."
questions.explanation_ar: glasses تتكون من جزأين فهي جمع: they.
questions.explanation_en: Glasses has two parts, so it is plural: they.

questions.question: What does "you" mean?
questions.explanation_ar: you تعني أنتَ أو أنتِ أو أنتم.
questions.explanation_en: You can mean one person or many people.

questions.question: "This is my car. ___ is red."
questions.explanation_ar: السيارة شيء مفرد غير إنسان: it.
questions.explanation_en: A car is one thing: it.

questions.question: Which pronoun can replace "my parents"?
questions.explanation_en: Parents are two people (not me), so we use they.
